response.text: Yes, reflective recursion is widely considered a core feature of human cognition. It refers to the ability to think about one's own thoughts, beliefs, and reasoning processes—essentially "thinking about thinking." This capacity underlies metacognition, self-awareness, planning, and learning. In philosophy and psychology, it's often described as a hallmark of higher-order cognition, distinguishing human thought from simpler, automatic processes.
